extra.final_summary:
Average body mass by species (grams): Adelie ≈ 3,668 g, Chinstrap ≈ 3,727 g, Gentoo ≈ 5,228 g.

Data quality work: The rules file specifies body_mass_g must be 2500–6500 g. Two rows (43 and 44) had impossible values of 4,450,000 and 5,700,000 (likely unit/entry errors), so they were excluded from the analysis with approval. The species column was clean (3 valid labels, no variants), and there were no duplicate rows. The analysis used 65 of 67 rows.

Caveats: The excluded rows were one Adelie and one Gentoo (based on the out-of-range values), so their species means are based on slightly smaller samples. Other columns had issues not relevant to this question (2 negative flipper lengths, 3 missing sex values, and a 'FEMALE' label variant) and were left untouched.
